facts.text: TaskManage task snapshots are stored as `pi-swarm-task-state` custom session entries; `import-taskmanage-history.ts` replays them by matching that customType.
`task-candidate-capture` extension calls `captureTaskCandidates` on `session_start` and on every `tool_result` whose toolName is `TaskManage`.
`captureTaskCandidates` writes one worktree-scope candidate record per session+task id (kind `context`, source `taskmanage:<session>:<id>`), creating a new revision when text or evidence changes.
`knowledge-enrichment` extracts candidate records with source `lifecycle-extraction` and evidence refs `<session>#<entryId>`; it runs on agent settle and `session_before_compact`.
`reviewOneCandidate` only selects candidates with exactly one evidence ref, which must load as a user or toolResult session entry, and then writes status `verified` with source `candidate-review:pi`.

Task-level TaskManage candidates get no re-verification at capture: evidence strings are stored raw, content is redacted, and dedupe is per task id only. The reviewer cannot load repo-file or `tool:` refs, so those records stay unverified.

Per-answer TaskManage records (kind `fact`, source `taskmanage-answer`) are written as `verified` only when `anchorAnswer` yields a span, heading or tool ref with no unresolved refs. Recall re-checks their evidence on every read. This corrects the claim that all TaskManage records are candidates.
`recallKnowledge` excludes every record whose status is not `verified`, so unverified TaskManage task-level candidates never reach bootstrap recall.
AGENTS.md's `project_context` row documents the sealed-eval decisions, the reproduce command `node tools/e2e/project-context-eval.mjs`, and the e2e command `node tools/e2e/project-context.mjs`.
AGENTS.md states that `project_context` has a downstream A−B pass rate of −0.067 [−0.333, +0.200] versus ripgrep, so no benefit is established, and that the agent never chose the tool unprompted.
